summary: Replace ShipRight's hand-built sign-in (own JWT, refresh tokens, password reset, Company/User tables, IsAdmin flag) with ASP.NET Core Identity backed by the existing Dapper-style data access (no EF Core), add the roles Admin, Operator and Viewer, add Google sign-in, and scope users, logins and roles per company (CompanyId). Decided: existing accounts and passwords keep working; desktop/local mode needs no sign-in and switches over transparently with no loss of data or projects; anyone can sign in with Google and a new company is created for them as Admin. Still open: how Operators and Viewers get into a company, since today the only way to get an account is to sign up and start a new company.

ask.text: Today every sign-up creates a brand-new company, and there is no way to add a teammate to an existing one. With the new Operator and Viewer roles, how should an Admin get other people into their company?
ask.why: It decides whether we build an invite or user-management screen and the endpoints behind it, how a teammate's account is created (password or Google), and what the tests check for joining and for changing someone's role.

options.label: Admin invites by email and picks the role
options.consequence: The Admin enters an email and a role (Admin, Operator or Viewer). The person follows the invite, sets a password or uses Google with that email, and lands in that company with that role. The Admin can also change or remove people later.

options.label: Admin creates the account directly
options.consequence: The Admin types the teammate's email, role and a starting password, and tells them. No email link needed, but the Admin handles passwords.

options.label: No teammates for now
options.consequence: Roles exist and are enforced, but each company still has only its first Admin. Smallest to build; Operator and Viewer cannot be given to anyone yet.

coverage.note: Roles decided (Admin, Operator, Viewer); desktop mode needs no auth; Google first sign-in creates a new company with that person as Admin. How other people join an existing company is still to confirm.
Existing User/Company records (email, password hash, CompanyId, IsAdmin) must stay valid; invite and Google link data depends on the open answer.
What Operator and Viewer may do will be assumed once the join flow is settled.
Password and email rules to assume once flows are settled.
Google button, invite and error states depend on the open answer.
Email is globally unique today; assume this stays.
Will assume small teams per company and a paged user list.
Removing users and ending their sessions; will assume default.
Email and Google profile data stored; will assume minimal.
Lockout, session lifetime; will assume defaults.
